source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Choosing the unit containing this model to attack lets you pay 1 **Pain token** to make it [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). This works for shooting on your turn and fighting on either turn. For its models’ attacks, you may reroll every **Hit** roll while the unit is [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain).
